rows.grounds: compound adjective qualifying mātṛk+ārṇān; bīja = seed-syllable, sampuṭita = enclosed
compound object of placement; mātṛkā = mother-syllable series, arṇa = syllable
indeclinable indicating sequence following the previous placement

items.question: How must the mātṛkā syllables be ritually placed following the limb-nyāsa?
premises: The mātṛkā syllables are the objects to be placed.
These syllables are enclosed by the seed syllable.
Their placement occurs immediately after the preceding act.
items.inference: The mātṛkā syllables are to be installed in sequence, each framed by the seed syllable.
uncertainties: The specific seed syllable intended is supplied by the preceding context rather than named in this verse.
items.plain_english: After that, having placed them, one should place the syllables of the mātṛkā enclosed by the seed syllable.
